items.name: cn
items.description: Class-name composer: merges conditional classes and resolves conflicting Tailwind utilities so a consumer's className always wins over a component's defaults.

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.description: The one implementation of the controlled/uncontrolled pattern (CONVENTIONS §4). Returns [value, setValue] with a referentially stable setter; a controlled component never updates its own state, and switching modes mid-life warns in development instead of silently picking a winner.

items.name: font-aspekta
items.description: Aspekta Variable — the design system's single typeface (SIL OFL 1.1, by Ivo Dolenc). Installs the @font-face CSS and the OFL license text; the ~30KB variable woff2 (weight 100-900) is binary and is fetched from the repo with the one-line curl documented at the top of aspekta.css, into the same directory. Keep OFL.txt with the font wherever it is deployed.

items.name: button
items.description: The primary action control. Four variants (primary, secondary, ghost, danger), three sizes (44/32/24px), pill or rounded, plus icon-only and full-width forms. Icon-only buttons require an aria-label at the type level. isBusy is visual-only and keeps focus, unlike isDisabled.

items.name: input
items.description: Single-line text field with its label, helper text and error message as one accessible unit. Three sizes (48/40/32px), leading and trailing slots. The label prop is required by the type system — a placeholder is not a label. errorText wires aria-invalid and aria-describedby together so the two cannot drift apart.

items.name: avatar
items.description: A person or entity as a photo or their initials. Circle or rounded, three sizes. `name` is required in both forms — it is the image's alt text and the source of the initials. Initials are aria-hidden and the full name exposed separately, so a screen reader announces the person rather than spelling out letters.

items.name: badge
items.description: A short status or selection label. Four variants (selected, unselected, success, danger), two sizes, pill or rounded, with an optional trailing slot. Renders a span and takes no interaction props: anything actionable is a real button passed into iconEnd, keeping the accessible name at the call site.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A binary choice with its label as one control. Supports the mixed/indeterminate state for a parent whose children are partly selected. The whole row is the 24px target; the painted box stays 18px. Controlled or uncontrolled through the shared useControllableState hook.

items.name: ui-craft
items.description: Agent skill: the craft rules for building interfaces with @bydiorama/ui — radii, elevation, motion, icons, hit areas, colour usage. Install so coding agents in your app apply the same polish standards as the design system itself. Adapted from jakubkrehel/skills (MIT), see CREDITS.md.
